purpose: Run of text in one of the typography variants display, h1 to h5, caption, or body that inherits its color from its container.
useWhen: Rendering a heading, paragraph, or caption in the design system's type scale.
Overriding the rendered element while keeping a variant's visual style.

avoidWhen.reason: Introducing a page section with an eyebrow, description, or actions — use section-heading instead.
Rendering Markdown content — compose the Markdown renderer instead.
